title: fix(harness): a host observer failure aborts bounded history seeding
body:
Fixes #177416

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: bounded history preparation aborts before the model call when the host's compaction observer throws or rejects.

## User Impact

A failing observer is logged and the bounded history remains available, so the turn can continue. Cancellation and revoked authority still reject preparation. No configuration changes or migration are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The host seed awaited the advisory `onAgentEvent` notification without containing its failure. The narrow catch now matches the other harness observers while preserving awaited ordering and the authority assertion after the callback.

The maintainer rewrite merges current main, retains @Chessing234's fix and both regression cases, uses the existing logger and `formatErrorMessage`, and adapts the regression to main's `seedFixture`. Obsolete setup and the logger spy are removed. The contributor's original commits remain in the branch history.

## Evidence

- Source and history confirm the uncontained observer await on main. The regression cases in `src/agents/harness/host-seed.test.ts` are `returns the bounded seed when the context observer throws` and `returns the bounded seed when the context observer rejects`; both check the omission notice and retained recent history after the callback fails.
- Changed-file oxlint, oxfmt, and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Isolated Codex autoreview at P0–P2: scoped-clean, no actionable findings. The final merge of main `7e3fdabe52a41` leaves the reviewed patch byte-identical.
- [ClawSweeper's exact-head review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/177453#issuecomment-6271838422): no code findings. Its remaining live-proof request is superseded by the explicit maintainer policy below; the conflict request is resolved.
- Exact-head [PR CI run 39586189703](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39586189703) passed for `336509435e751f3924a7c988e42f7ae465d27752`, including all selected Node tests, lint, production/test type checks, and the CI gate. The [follow-up gate publication](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39587698390/job/119180678028) also passed for this exact PR/head. CI is the test gate for the host-seed regressions and affected behavior.
- Runtime tests, local typechecks, and live proof were intentionally skipped per maintainer policy; contributor code was not executed locally. The prior review's additional proof requests are superseded by this policy. Local test timing and a runtime red/green comparison are not claimed.

The final diff against main is production +8/−1 (net +7), tests +32/−0, docs +0/−0. The production growth is the required observer containment, ownership comment, and existing logger/error-formatter imports; unrelated deletion would obscure the fix.
